user_message: You said honey flows slowly because it is viscous. But when I warm it, it flows much faster without becoming much less dense. What should we revise in the explanation?
allowed_evidence: Viscosity measures resistance to shear flow and can depend strongly on temperature. Density and viscosity are distinct properties. For many liquids, viscosity decreases substantially as temperature rises.
public_rubric: Connects warming to a molecular or measurable change in flow resistance.
